# heytownhall_spend_cap (Resource)

The organisation's monthly spending cap on live requests. There is one cap per organisation. When the month's bill would pass it, live requests answer `402 spend_cap_reached`.

Destroying the resource removes the cap.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap live spending at 500 US dollars a month. Leave `cents` out for no cap.
resource "heytownhall_spend_cap" "monthly" {
  cents = 50000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cents` (Number) The cap in US cents per month, at least 1. Leave it out (null) for no cap.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organisation's id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the organisation's id.
terraform import heytownhall_spend_cap.monthly 11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
